cards.title: PD Target Definition and Applicability
cards.claim: A PD target (PDT) must specify the effect (e.g., stasis, 1-log kill), index (e.g., fAUC/MIC), units, concentration basis (free/total), and exposure window. A target awaiting fitting is a planned output. A reported target from another context requires explicit applicability assessment before use in PTA.
conditions: Before using a PDT in PTA simulation.
When comparing indices (e.g., fAUC/MIC vs fT>MIC).
When translating animal-derived targets to human scenarios.
required_inputs: Source of target and its experimental context.
limitations: A target from one species or infection site may not apply to another.
Index ranking requires separated dose/frequency effects.
Do not borrow MICs or targets from other drugs.
cards.downstream_use: Input for PTA simulation; qualification of PK/PD cutoff.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
